title: The Blue Hour of the reservoir
author: Mirabel Sandoval
blurb: Marguerite Hartwell, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
